description: Defines the OutlineListItem node for a rich text editor, including its attributes, HTML parsing/rendering, keyboard shortcuts, and node view rendering.

classes.name: OutlineListItem
classes.description: A custom node for outline list items with collapsible functionality and nested list support.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Provides default options for the node, such as HTML attributes.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Defines node attributes, including 'collapsed' state with HTML parsing and rendering logic.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Specifies how to parse HTML elements into this node type.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Defines how to render this node as HTML.

methods.name: addKeyboardShortcuts
methods.description: Adds keyboard shortcut handlers for toggling collapse, splitting, sinking, and lifting list items.

methods.name: addNodeView
methods.description: Creates a custom DOM representation for the node, including click handling for collapsing/expanding.
